title.narrative: Capacity building to protect human rights defenders and civil society organisations in five Asian countries
Kapazitätsstärkung zum Schutz von Menschenrechtsverteidigenden und zivilgesellschaftlichen Organisationen in fünf asiatischen Ländern

description.narrative: Human rights defenders in Asia are increasingly exposed to threats. They experience state and non-state violence, surveillance, harassment and gender-specific attacks. Indonesia, Myanmar, Nepal, Pakistan and the Philippines are particularly affected. The pandemic has further exacerbated these risks through restrictions and increased control.
